To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we have demonstrated a touchless 3 D fingerprint detection and spoofing detection system using single shot projection of sinusoidal fringes and biospeckles analysis respectively.
we have developed a touchless 3 D fingerprint detection system that can detect real, layered, dead and fake fingers.
a single shot fringe projection based 3D fingerprint reconstruction system is developed and a biospeckle based fingerprint anti spoofing technique is proposed.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design and implementation of a touchless, fast, non invasive and low cost 3D fingerprint system for spoof detection.
the development of an anti spoof 3D fingerprint system using a combination single shot fringe projection, and biospeckles analysis.
the development of a touch less, non mechanical, low cost 3D fingerprint system that is capable of detecting fake prints and dead fingers.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the proposed system is a promising solution for anti spoof 3D fingerprint identification and authentication.

the proposed method is capable of detecting spoof fingers with an accuracy of 100% and is capable of detecting live fingers with an accuracy greater than 99% with a false rejection rate of less than 0.5%.
the proposed system is an effective, robust and reliable method for 3D fingerprint identification and anti spoofing.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the combination of single shot projection based 3D fingerprint and biospeckles based anti spoofing is highly efficient and can be used for a wide range of biometric applications.
the proposed system provides an efficient, robust and low cost fingerprint identification system that is capable of detecting spoof materials.
the proposed system can be a good alternative to conventional 2D fingerprint detection systems.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the proposed method can be easily implemented in the existing 2D fingerprint detection systems for anti spoofing applications.
, the proposed method provides a touchless and anti spoof 3D fingerprint identification and detection system.
, the proposed touchless system can provide 3D information of a fingerprint and can detect a fake finger.
